segments.subgoal: Explain the three broad categories of interaction in immersive experiences.
Distinguish object selection from object manipulation as the two main types of object interaction.
Describe the parameters that affect object selection and list the main selection technique categories.
Explain hand-based selection techniques, including virtual hand, go-go, prism, and intent-driven selection.
Explain pointing-based selection techniques, including ray casting, bend cast, and depth ray.
Explain image-plane and volumetric selection techniques, including framing and bimanual volumetric selection.
Describe what object manipulation entails and list the main categories of manipulation techniques.
Explain hand-based object manipulation and its practical requirements.
Explain indirect manipulation techniques, including 3D widgets, indirect proxies, and world-in-miniature.
Explain bimanual manipulation techniques, including spindle and spindle-plus-wheel.
Explain integrated hybrid manipulation, especially the HOMER technique that combines ray selection with hand manipulation.
Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the remaining navigation and system-control interaction topics.
